name: extracting-article-insights
description: Extract key insights, themes, and quotable points from a source article for content repurposing. Use when the user wants to analyze an article, blog post, newsletter, or report to identify the most compelling points for reuse across channels. Produces a structured list of numbered insights with summaries, source quotes, and relevance tags. Accepts the article as an argument: a URL (most common) or an uploaded document.
